statement: Let $\Gamma$ be the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$. $D$ is on $BC$. The tangent to $\Gamma$ at $A$ meets the parallel to $BA$ through $D$ at $E$. $CE$ meets $\Gamma$ again at $F$. Suppose $B,D,F,E$ are concyclic. Prove $AC$, $BF$, $DE$ are concurrent.

Show that $r = 2$ is the largest real with the following property: if a sequence of positive integers satisfies $a_n \leq a_{n+2} \leq \sqrt{a_n^2 + r a_{n+1}}$ for all $n$, then $a_{n+2} = a_n$ for all sufficiently large $n$.

Find all positive integers $k$ for which there exist a positive integer $m$ and a set $S$ of positive integers such that every integer $n > m$ can be written as a sum of distinct elements of $S$ in exactly $k$ ways.
Find all polynomials $P(x)$ with integer coefficients such that for any bijection $a : \mathbb{Z}^+ \to \mathbb{Z}$, there exist indices $i < j$ and an integer $k$ with $a_i + \cdots + a_j = P(k)$.

The number 1 is written $n \geq 3$ times. A move: erase $a$ and $b$, write 1 and $a+b$, add 1 stone to bucket 1 and $\gcd(a,b)$ stones to bucket 2. After finitely many moves, bucket 1 has $s$ stones and bucket 2 has $t$ stones. Find all possible values of $s/t$.
